name: Exp_X2MA
summary: This EA trades based on crossover signals from a double-smoothed moving average indicator (X2MA). It opens buy positions when the X2MA values turn upward and sell positions when they turn downward, with configurable permissions for entry and exit. The strategy applies two sequential smoothing algorithms to a selected price type to generate trend-following signals.
summary_zh: 该EA基于双重平滑移动平均线指标(X2MA)的交叉信号进行交易。当X2MA数值向上转折时开多仓，向下转折时开空仓，并可配置入场和出场的权限。策略对选定价格类型依次应用两种平滑算法来生成趋势跟踪信号。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于双重平滑移动平均线的方向变化来捕捉趋势转折点。入场条件为：当X2MA指标值连续上升（Value[1]<Value[2]且Value[0]>Value[1]）时产生买入信号，当指标值连续下降（Value[1]>Value[2]且Value[0]<Value[1]）时产生卖出信号。出场条件依赖固定点数的止损和止盈，同时当反向信号出现时也允许平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算手数。资金管理依赖TradeAlgorithms.mqh中的函数实现，支持基于账户余额百分比的动态仓位计算。该策略本质上是一个趋势跟踪系统，通过双重平滑减少假信号，但在震荡行情中可能频繁产生错误信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on detecting trend reversals through direction changes in a double-smoothed moving average (X2MA). Entry conditions are: a buy signal is generated when X2MA values consecutively rise (Value[1]<Value[2] and Value[0]>Value[1]), and a sell signal is generated when values consecutively decline (Value[1]>Value[2] and Value[0]<Value[1]). Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss and take profit in points, while reverse signals also permit position closing when enabled. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent deposit share-based calculations. Money management leverages functions from TradeAlgorithms.mqh, supporting dynamic position sizing based on account balance percentage. The strategy is fundamentally a trend-following system that uses double smoothing to reduce false signals, but may generate frequent whipsaw losses in ranging markets.

parameters.description_en: Deposit percentage or fixed lot; negative = lot size

parameters.name: Deviation_

parameters.description_en: First smoothing parameter (JJMA: -100~+100, VIDYA: CMO period, AMA: slow MA period)

pros: 双重平滑算法有效减少市场噪声和假信号
支持10种平滑方法和9种价格类型，策略参数灵活可调
买卖开仓和平仓权限可独立控制，便于灵活配置策略组合
使用IsNewBar机制避免同根K线内重复交易
止损止盈参数完备，风险控制有基本保障
pros_en: Double smoothing algorithm effectively reduces market noise and false signals
Supports 10 smoothing methods and 9 price types, offering highly flexible parameter configuration
Buy/sell open and close permissions can be independently controlled for flexible strategy combinations
Uses IsNewBar mechanism to prevent duplicate trades within the same bar
Complete stop loss and take profit parameters provide basic risk control
cons: 缺乏震荡行情过滤器，在横盘市场中容易频繁开仓平仓造成连续亏损
没有点差过滤和滑点保护机制，在高点差环境下交易成本可能过大
止损1000点止盈2000点的默认值过大，可能导致单笔亏损严重
依赖外部自定义指标X2MA和SmoothAlgorithms.mqh库，缺少独立性和可移植性
没有最大持仓限制和连续亏损保护机制
cons_en: Lacks a ranging market filter, prone to frequent whipsaw entries and exits in sideways markets
No spread filter or slippage protection mechanism, trading costs may be excessive in high-spread environments
Default stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are very large, potentially causing severe single-trade losses
Depends on external custom indicator X2MA and SmoothAlgorithms.mqh library, reducing portability and independence
No maximum position limit or consecutive loss protection mechanism
improvements: 增加ADX或波动率过滤器，在低趋势强度或震荡行情中禁止开仓
增加点差过滤和最大持仓数量限制，降低交易成本风险和过度暴露风险
添加追踪止损功能以更好地保护浮动盈利
improvements_en: Add ADX or volatility filter to disable trading during low-trend-strength or ranging conditions
Add spread filter and maximum position count limit to reduce trading cost risk and overexposure risk
Add trailing stop functionality to better protect floating profits

risk_points: 默认止损1000点过大，单笔交易可能造成严重亏损
无点差过滤，高点差品种可能频繁触发止损
趋势跟踪策略在震荡市中可能产生连续亏损
MM参数为-0.1时使用固定0.1手，未考虑账户资金规模
risk_points_en: Default stop loss of 1000 points is very large, potentially causing severe single-trade losses
No spread filter, high-spread instruments may frequently trigger stop losses
Trend-following strategy may produce consecutive losses in ranging markets
When MM=-0.1, fixed 0.1 lot is used regardless of account size
